_doc: Issue #399 prototype: multi-phase FX sequences read by src/battle/FractalFX.gd. Times are BATTLE seconds (they scale with battle speed like every other battle animation). A phase starts at `at`. kind=emit is the recursive primitive: `count` flames over `arc` degrees (360 = radial symmetry) out to `radius`; each becomes the origin of `child` (a different spec) or, with `depth`, of a smaller copy of itself (`decay` = size, `time_decay` = life). Not wired to any ability yet: judged on clips from tools/fx_clip.sh first.

fire_fractal.label: Fire: bolt, burst, fan, re-burst, spin and fling
fire_fractal.start_note: mage/cast releases on f6 at 750 ms (cowir-sprites, read by eye on the artist strip)

fire_depth_1.label: Depth knob, tier 1: one burst, one recursion
fire_depth_1.start_note: mage/cast releases on f6 at 750 ms (cowir-sprites, read by eye on the artist strip)

fire_depth_3.label: Depth knob, tier 3: the same burst recursing three times
fire_depth_3.start_note: mage/cast releases on f6 at 750 ms (cowir-sprites, read by eye on the artist strip)

strike_impact.label: Physical: lunge with afterimages, slash trail, impact frames, hit-stop, sparks, knockback
strike_impact.start_note: fighter/attack contacts on f3 at 375 ms; f0 carries the artist's own slash smear, so afterimages start at f1 (cowir-sprites)

fire_battle.label: Fire: heat gathers, a flame flies, the original eruption, embers (main 23590)
fire_battle.start_note: mage/cast releases on f6 at 750 ms; damage lands at the eruption

sig_cave_rat_king.label: Rat King: Rat Swarm, the court spills out of him in rings of rot

sig_fire_dragon.label: Pyrroth: Inferno Rage, a spinning furnace that throws three waves

sig_ice_dragon.label: Glacius: Absolute Zero, a frost bolt, a crystal bloom, a held breath, the shatter

sig_lightning_dragon.label: Voltharion: Lightning Dash, afterimages and a branching strike

sig_shadow_dragon.label: Umbraxis: Void Breath, a dark aura, a beam, a recursive unmaking

sig_chancellor_mordaine.label: Mordaine: Summary Judgment, three seals, the bolt of the finding, the stamp

sig_cave_rat_king_wave.label: Rat King: the swarm pours across the floor onto each member

sig_fire_dragon_wave.label: Pyrroth: the inferno breaks over each member

glory_firaga.label: Firaga: a huge gather, flames on every foe, the eruption, a pillar, a SECOND detonation, embers (main 23590)
glory_firaga.start_note: mage/cast releases on f6 at 750 ms, like fire_battle

glory_blizzaga.label: Blizzaga: the air freezes, a crystal bloom, a held breath, the shatter
glory_blizzaga.start_note: mage/cast releases on f6 at 750 ms

glory_thundaga.label: Thundaga: a fat bolt, a branching crack, the sky answers
glory_thundaga.start_note: mage/cast releases on f6 at 750 ms

summon_overclock.label: Overclock: the furnace golem vents Thermal Throttle across the field
summon_overclock.start_note: the figure has already risen during the wind-up; the sequence fires from the stage

summon_cold_storage.label: Cold Storage: Deep Archive, the field filed under ice
summon_cold_storage.start_note: the figure has already risen during the wind-up; the sequence fires from the stage

summon_surge_protector.label: Surge Protector: Brownout, every bolt at once
summon_surge_protector.start_note: the figure has already risen during the wind-up; the sequence fires from the stage

summon_legacy_system.label: Legacy System: Hard Reset, the old dragon powers the whole field down
summon_legacy_system.start_note: the figure has already risen during the wind-up

summon_recursive.label: Recursive Summon: a summoner summons a summoner summons a summoner
summon_recursive.start_note: self-aimed: every phase lands on the caster, rings within rings

edit_formula_battle.label: Edit Formula: the fractal that was Fire's (main 23590): bolt, burst, fan, re-burst, fling, in glitch cyan
edit_formula_battle.palette_note: glitch: the game rewriting itself; no fire tones (struktured preferred Fire's original eruption)

fira_battle.label: Fira: a bigger gather, flame, eruption, a pillar of fire, embers (main 23590)

melee_power_strike.label: Power Strike: blade glint, one heavy vertical arc, a ground crack that fills the enemy side (sprites 23767, main 23768)

melee_cleave.label: Cleave: one wide crescent swept across the whole enemy line (played ONCE, at the line's centre)

melee_cleave_cut.label: Cleave: the cut on EACH foe as the edge passes it (the hook staggers them along the line)

melee_shield_bash.label: Shield Bash: a dash streak, then a blunt star and a flat ring (a wall, not a cut)

melee_slash.label: Slash: a fast X, two crossed diagonal cuts 0.06 s apart

melee_backstab.label: Backstab: the Rogue's shadow streaks BEHIND the target, then one thin stab from behind

melee_backstab_crit.label: Backstab on a CRIT: a second, delayed slash bloom

melee_mug.label: Mug: two quick cuts, then the take pops out of the target and arcs back to the Rogue

landed_stun.label: A stun LANDS: three stars orbit in over the target's head

landed_blind.label: A blind LANDS: the smoke closes over the target's eyes

landed_taunt.label: Provoke LANDS: a crosshair pulse settles on the target

fizzle.label: An effect FAILS or is resisted: a grey fizzle to dust, never the landed beat

steal_take.label: Steal SUCCEEDS: the take glints and arcs back to the Rogue

rogue_steal.label: Steal: a quick hand-swipe at the target (the outcome beat follows: steal_take or fizzle)

fighter_provoke.label: Provoke: a red shout-ring from the Fighter and a tether that snaps to the target (landed_taunt or fizzle follows) The caster phases sit 80 px toward the enemy: a cast's origin is the caster's hand anchor, right of the Fighter's body (measured on the clip).

rogue_scan.label: Scan: a green scanline sweeps down the target and three brackets lock on

rogue_smoke_bomb.label: Smoke Bomb: a small arc toss, then a grey cloud that billows over the enemy line and thins

rogue_shadow_step.label: Shadow Step: the Rogue smears into three fading afterimages and re-forms over a dark ground ripple

cure_battle.label: Cure: light gathers at her staff, arcs to the ally, a soft column rises with sparkles (cutscenes 23771)

cura_battle.label: Cura: cure one tier up: two braided arcs, a wider column, a ground ring and a second wave of sparkles

crystal_heal_battle.label: Crystal Heal: a ring of light closes in on the caster, flashes, and rises

regen_battle.label: Regen: green light climbs the ally and leaves leaf motes drifting up

esuna_battle.label: Esuna: a white ring sweeps down the ally head to foot and the dross falls away

pray_battle.label: Pray: three blue motes drift to the ally and pop (a free move: kept small)

raise_battle.label: Raise (the showcase): a shaft of light drops on the fallen ally, feathers fall inside it, a halo bursts and the shaft lifts away

protect_battle.label: Protect: gold plates fly in and lock into a honeycomb wall in front of the ally

shell_battle.label: Shell: violet plates arch into a dome that closes over the ally

battle_hymn_battle.label: Battle Hymn: a red-gold staff ribbon runs from the Bard down the party line and a rising note bursts on each ally as it arrives

inspiring_melody_battle.label: Inspiring Melody: a blue staff ribbon washes down the party line; notes and blue light rise from each ally

lullaby_battle.label: Lullaby: three slow notes drift from the Bard to the foe and settle on it (the sleep itself is the landed beat)

discord_battle.label: Discord: a jagged violet ribbon snaps across to each foe and the notes shatter on it

melee_riff.label: Riff, at contact: a sour chord rings off the instrument and its notes scatter (the hit itself is the melee path's)

landed_sleep.label: A sleep LANDS: Z's drift up from the sleeper
